BiblicalUsage: At Hezekiah's passover, many in the congregation were not sanctified, so the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD. The word is the slaughtering itself, the work of making the offering ready.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse shows grace inside the law, for the people were not ready so the Levites stood in their place, and I hold that God still provides a stand-in for the unready.
